verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail has a dedicated check-deposit page stating checks can be deposited without visiting the bank, billed per deposit with no setup or monthly fees, and with savings for batching multiple checks. That is only the outline of the pricing model, not the actual terms. missing for 10: list of supported banks, actual per-deposit fee amounts, deposit turnaround time, what happens to the physical check after deposit, and any independent corroboration.
